input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

amplicon_manifest.help_text: Header row required. Column names are matched after stripping punctuation/case (guide_.1/guide_1/Guide1 all work): project_name, plate_name, well_position, gene_name, gene_id, species, guide1, guide2, guide3, amplicon_size, fwd_primer, rev_primer. Guides are given as RNA (U) and converted to DNA; primers are the plain fwd_primer/rev_primer columns (not adaptor-tagged final_* columns).

fastq_manifest.description: Tab-separated fastq manifest (sample, project_name, fastq_1, fastq_2, optional donor).
fastq_manifest.help_text: Header row required with columns sample, project_name, fastq_1, fastq_2 and an optional donor column ('none' if not applicable). Each sample is screened with CRISPRessoPooled against only the amplicons whose amplicon-manifest project_name matches; samples whose project has no amplicons are skipped with a warning.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome, gene annotation and prebuilt index options.

ref_fai.help_text: Defaults to `${ref_fasta}.fai`; built with `samtools faidx` if missing.

bwa_index_prefix.description: Prefix of a prebuilt BWA index (amb/ann/bwt/pac/sa).
bwa_index_prefix.help_text: Defaults to `ref_fasta`; built with `bwa index` if missing.

gene_bed.description: Gene BED file (chrom, start0, end, gene_id, gene_name, strand).
gene_bed.help_text: One of `gene_bed`/`genes_gtf` is required. If not supplied, it is built from `genes_gtf`.

exon_bed.description: Exon BED file; adds an `overlapping_exons` column to `validation_report.tsv`.

genes_gtf.description: Ensembl GTF used to build `gene_bed`/`exon_bed` if `gene_bed` isn't supplied.

amplicon_mapping_options.title: Amplicon mapping options
amplicon_mapping_options.description: Tuning for the two-BWA-pass amplicon mapping. See mapping_amplicons/README.md for full rationale.

bwa_n.description: Max edit distance for the off-target (mismatch-tolerant) BWA pass.

max_xa.description: Max alternative hits BWA reports per query in the mismatch-tolerant pass.

max_mismatch.description: Edit-distance threshold for a hit to count as a high-quality off-target.

gene_window.description: bp padding around each gene when checking guide/primer overlap.

high_copy_threshold.description: Flag guide/primer as HIGH_COPY_NUMBER above this many tied-best hits.

reassign_primary.description: Promote gene-matching tied alternates to primary; log + write corrected BAM.

crispresso_n_processes.description: Number of CRISPRessoPooled processes to run in parallel (n_processes).

crispresso_min_reads_to_use_region.description: Minimum reads assigned to an amplicon for CRISPRessoPooled to analyse it (min_reads_to_use_region; CRISPResso's own default is 1000). Amplicons below this appear as not_aligned in the report.

report_edit_threshold.description: Edit % at or above which a tested sample x amplicon pair counts as a successful edit.

report_wt_max_edit.description: Edit % at or below which a tested WT sample x amplicon pair counts as success_wt (no editing); above it the pair fails.

report_min_reads.description: Minimum aligned reads for a sample x amplicon pair to count as tested.

report_wt_pattern.description: Regex matched against donor (or sample name if donor is 'none'); matching samples are reported separately as WT.

report_plate_format.description: Plate layout for the plate heatmaps; 'auto' picks the smallest standard plate that fits.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline.

skip_checks.description: Skip the nf-schema and custom manifest checks.
